calibration_policy: Choose class power/ridge/gain on the 192 train-side judgments excluded from each partial solve; the externally published donor was previously trained on this split. Then refit the chosen full-scale head on all 4,984. The 72 validation IDs have not been used by this scaling family; unrelated historical validation exposure may exist.
selection_key: macro-F1 then accuracy on train-side calibration
primary_contender: Of donor-state and retention-state heads at 4792, select on the fixed train calibration then lock the 4984 direct refit; all smaller scales serve as controls.
gate: On 72 untouched-by-family validation judgments, require positive lower 95% judgment-bootstrap macro-F1 gap vs the matching frozen 240-case head (native baseline matched for presence or absence of the 200 gate entries). Require point macro-F1 > freshly refit 240-example-scale arm, no point accuracy loss vs frozen 240. Do not score official test without separate authorization.
cache_source: known-sentence-pair-edit per-doc states where verified from matching inputs; recurrent-inverse/fit cached native word vectors; saved new word vectors pinned to parent model SHA.
